key_insight: AI can unify fragmented experimental and theoretical knowledge to diagnose, model, and mitigate instability in 3D inorganic perovskites such as CsPbX3.
engineering_relevance: The review frames AI as a practical tool for designing more stable perovskite solar cells, detectors, and LEDs by accelerating failure prediction and guiding durability-focused engineering.
method: Consequences/reliability modeling and engineering strategy optimization
evidence_signal: The abstract highlights that existing studies are constrained by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-based analysis.
watch_item: Performance and transferability can be limited by inconsistent data quality, nonstandard protocols, weak benchmarks, and limited interpretability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
